subject: Oh lordy lorks alive..
author: kevlar0
body:
I was absolutley dreading this update, due to the fact they (the Doghouse) have been messing with the car stats, They said on there news page that it was only the lower cars that had been tampered with, my heart sank when i just read the X12 and nearly all the others had been changed/noobified, i can only hope they haven't taken the inner beast out of the X12, just so unskilled players can drive it, that would be pandering to the masses just for the sake of it.

It looks to me that Criterion have lost all integrity, and have killed what could have been THE best Burnout to date, the dumbing down of Paradise in this latest update is a real shame, and will probably be a game killer for a lot of old school burners. It looks like Mr Ward is reeking his "Revenge" on us hardcore burners for slagging his game off and suggesting things that would make better gameplay, I imagine he is laughing his ass off at us, the people who bought your previous games, to put you where you are now.

Don't forget Alex, its nice to be at the top, but it can be a long painful fall back down. Sh1tting on your hardcore fans must have given you immense satisfaction.

He's not the messiah, he's a very naughty boy.

subject: There were things wrong with the game...
author: ZombieTron
body:
and I am really pleased with some of the v1.6 changes.

The Fog does seem lighter, and no longer a reason to not play at all.

Night time does look more interesting now, I also hated playing in the Bike pack version of Night time, so I will play more now.

Burnout Paradise was not perfect before, and it's not perfect now, some things are better, some things are a little different and I'm not used to them yet.

The flashing bill boards are a bit annoying, but I can live with it, I know people struggled to get all the collectables without using maps and guides before, so if the game can now be completed without guides then it is a good thing.

The Road Rage change is a bit of a shame in a way... but I can see why it was done. When I first started playing BP I didn't pull over to finish the event and just kept going beyond the target. The new system will mean you don't have to force end the event and it will make the offline game flow a little better.

Overall I think all of the changes are improvements. Good Job CG! 🙂

subject: Interesting...
author: Khanon
body:
...is the look really that different on PS3/XBox from the PC? I bought the PC version yesterday and have been playing for about 20 hours solid. The colors seem "realistic" enough and the blue lights for the super jump markers stand out because of it. As well, the smash through barriers being yellow (many with lights if you're on an overpass/bridge/elevated road) make them stand out too without being "phony" looking.

*shrugs* I don't know how the cars handled before, but they are great right now (as far as I'm concerned, anyway), and if there were cars with maxed stats in areas, it would make it tough to add new cars that are actually better down the road (such as the island expansion).

Now...I'm sure in some dark corner of this site, I can find something other than rampant complaining...after all, the site name protends a haven of fans not haters, but so far, I'm coming up empty... *goes back to rummaging through things*
